deadlines.dateText: The **regular application** deadline is **28 May** during the first year of the Master's programme. If you plan to apply for [Erasmus](https://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/en/studium/erasmus/outgoing.html) funding in parallel, please submit your application by **10 March**.
deadlines.sourceQuote: The **regular application** deadline is **28 May** during the first year of the Master's programme. If you plan to apply for [Erasmus](https://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/en/studium/erasmus/outgoing.html) funding in parallel, please submit your application by **10 March**.
